title: Are You Smarter Than a Barstool?
eventType: Are You Smarter Than a Barstool?
theme: Are You Smarter Than a Barstool?
shortDescription: School-subject trivia for adults at The Mill at Fountain Inn.
description: You learned it once. How much stuck? Bring your people to The Mill for school-subject trivia, Four Dogs Sound Check, and a Final Wager. Food and drinks are available from the venue; trivia is free to play.

admission.note: Trivia is free to play. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
